status: proposal (P10.0-00, synthetic data only; the human confirms or changes it)

melody.description: Flag a card when a used note is the highest note of the span and started before the card (held over from the previous one), or when a used note belongs to a voice whose pre-analysis role is melody and its pitch class is not a chord tone of the card name.

percussion.description: A pitch is percussion-like when at least minRepeatsInSong of its notes last shortMaxBeats or less and start on the gridBeats grid. Flag a card when a used note has such a pitch. 'Select the same short notes' uses the same shortMaxBeats (spec 7.2).

sameChordSplit.compare: pitch-class set of used notes + lowest used pitch
sameChordSplit.description: Flag a card when the next card's used notes have the same pitch-class set and the same lowest pitch. Shift+M merges only these (exact match).

reviewLimits.note: Spec 1: a flag rate target (false flags per 100 cards) is set after the P10.0-07 measurement; none is fixed here.
